item.title: A pilot of the Amazon cargo plane in Miami crash warned it was coming in too fast
item.description: For nearly two minutes, one of the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane that careened off a Miami runway repeatedly warned his counterpart they were going too fast, according to flight information.

item.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
item.description: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

item.title: Conductor Julian Wachner receives suspended sentence for possession of child sex abuse material
item.description: The formerly prominent, widely recorded conductor was sentenced Wednesday to nearly six years of probation for five counts of possession of child sex abuse material in Indianapolis.

item.description: Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.

item.title: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
item.description: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.

item.title: Whatever happened to the measles outbreak that shocked a country this year?
item.description: Bangladesh has seen over 50,000 confirmed or suspected cases of measles this year. The death toll among children just surpassed 1,000. How are officials trying to bring the outbreak under control?

item.title: Trump officials propose sweeping changes to the census that would reshape voting maps
item.description: A Trump census proposal would stop asking about race and exclude millions of U.S. residents from a count that the 14th Amendment says must include the "whole number of persons in each state."
